ops.why: The spring that gives Greenspring its name rises here, beside the spring house.
The bed-keeper sells beds and rope at the lodge door.
The bed-keeper sleeps in the lodge.
The bed-keeper rents the lodge beds and sells rope and stores.
The root-herald trades at the door of the house.
The root-herald sleeps in the house.
The root-herald trades with Helstrom and buys from travellers.
The tree-minder tends the Hist and its shrine.
The tree-minder sleeps in the house beside the tree.
The tree-minder speaks for the Hist and keeps its shrine.
The spring-keeper pours water for travellers at the stone lip.
The spring-keeper sleeps in the house above the spring.
The spring-keeper keeps the spring clean and pours it for anyone who asks.
The family cooks at the oven in front of the hut.
The family sleeps in the hut.
A family of the village lives and cooks at the hut.
